newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo slips on mark despite firmer dollar.
newsitem.headline: Escudo slips on mark despite firmer dollar.

text.p: The escudo slipped against the mark on Monday, ignoring the strength of the dollar and pound sterling. But trade was thin, dealers said.
The escudo opened at 100.84/87 per mark and at 0855 GMT stood at 100.87/90.
"The escudo is showing a very slight tendency to drop against the mark, but what stands out is that the market has little liquidity", said one dealer.
Traders saw the currency moving in a range of 100.80-101.00 during the day.
